name: bug
description: Something is broken or behaves incorrectly.

name: enhancement
description: Requested improvement or new capability.

name: documentation
description: Improvements or additions to the docs.

name: question
description: Needs an answer rather than a change.

name: duplicate
description: Already reported in another issue or PR.

name: invalid
description: Not a problem with TFSaz, or not actionable.

name: wontfix
description: Out of scope or deliberately not changed.

name: needs-triage
description: Needs maintainer review and initial categorization.

name: needs-more-info
description: Waiting on the reporter.

name: dependencies
description: Dependency update opened by Dependabot.

name: platform:macos
description: Specific to macOS.

name: platform:windows
description: Specific to Windows.

name: platform:linux
description: Specific to Linux, including WSL.

name: t3-compatibility
description: How T3 Code invokes az, or a T3 version that calls it differently.

name: routing
description: Synthetic URL routing: redirector, link handler, extension, Git launcher.

name: size:XS
description: 0-9 changed lines without go.sum, and without tests in mixed PRs.

name: size:S
description: 10-29 changed lines without go.sum, and without tests in mixed PRs.

name: size:M
description: 30-99 changed lines without go.sum, and without tests in mixed PRs.

name: size:L
description: 100-499 changed lines without go.sum, and without tests in mixed PRs.

name: size:XL
description: 500-999 changed lines without go.sum, and without tests in mixed PRs.

name: size:XXL
description: 1,000+ changed lines without go.sum, and without tests in mixed PRs.

name: agent-context-increase
description: A maintainer accepts that this PR grows the context every agent session loads.
